subject: Post-demo: data handling commitments & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@summithealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: data handling commitments & next steps

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for your time on the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so Summit Health has a written record we can attach to the contract: 

1) Model learning: Summit Health has requested that customer data from production and sandbox traffic not be used to update or improve any Redwood models. We will record a formal Training Exclusion on the account and block any downstream model tuning.

2) PII handling: We will enable our PII-redaction pipeline on your routes by default. That pipeline masks the following fields unless explicitly whitelisted: SSN, patient identifiers, credit card numbers, and free-text patient notes matching PHI patterns.

3) Logging & retention: Default request/response logs are retained for 30 days for debugging. As discussed, we can shorten retention to 14 days for EU-facing deployments; please confirm preference. Logs that contain PII will be redacted at ingest.

4) Data residency: You asked for EU data residency for logs and model-serving. We will host your account in our Frankfurt region for both runtime and log storage.

5) Access & audit: We can provide role-based secure access to audit logs (SFTP or customer-managed AWS bucket) for your SOC team during audit windows. Any ad-hoc exports will be tracked and require a 2FA approval by Summit's security lead.

I attached the current DPA and a short Training Exclusion Addendum draft. If Summit confirms: (a) "no model learning" is correct, (b) 14- or 30-day log retention, and (c) preferred audit access method — we'll generate the formal amendment and push to DocuSign.

Next steps I propose: 
- Emily: confirm the three bullets above in a reply (one-line is fine)
- Marissa & Legal: prepare amendment and DocuSign envelope once Emily confirms
- Soojin: advise on any technical caveats for disabled model updates and log delivery

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if any of this needs a quick walkthrough.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: DPA_v3.pdf (PDF), training_exclusion_addendum.pdf (PDF)

From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@summithealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Park <j.park@summithealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 16:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data handling commitments & next steps

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. We want to confirm the following so legal can sign quickly: 

• Confirmed: Summit Health requires that no customer interactions (production or staging) be used to improve Redwood models — this includes feature-store snapshots, embeddings collection, and any off-line fine-tuning datasets.

• Retention: We'd prefer 14-day log retention for EU residency to align with our internal policy, but we need a carve-out to retrieve logs up to 12 months if required for a regulatory investigation (export under strict approval). Is that feasible?

• Debugging access: Our security team wants to know whether you can provide redacted logs for debugging with the option to grant time-limited visibility into full logs under a strict request/approval workflow. We do not want permanent external access to raw logs.

• Audit: Who will be the Redwood contact for SOC audit requests? We need a named person for our vendor inventory.

If you can confirm those items I can get this routed to procurement/legal and we can sign the addendum.

—Emily
Emily Santos
Head of Infrastructure Security, Summit Health
emily.santos@summithealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@summithealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 02:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data handling commitments & next steps

Hi Emily — quick technical notes to address your questions: 

• Scope of "no model learning": We will disable any pipelines that export user interactions to our training/feature-store tier. That includes embeddings capture for feature-search and any snapshot exports used by ML teams. Note: real-time inference caches (KV cache) are separate; we can disable persistent KV caching for your account if you prefer no transient context to be kept beyond a single request.

• 14-day retention + regulatory carve-out: We can set the default retention to 14 days for the EU tenant and implement an audited export process for regulatory holds. Exports for regulatory investigations will be manual, require Summit sign-off, and be logged in our audit trail. We will not keep a rolling 12-month export unless explicitly requested for legal reasons.

• Debugging & time-limited visibility: We support two options: (1) redacted log bundles delivered to your SFTP for standard debugging, or (2) time-limited full-log access via a temporary signed URL to a customer-managed bucket with MFA and an approval ticket. Both options are captured in the attached security brief.

• Audit contact: For SOC/audit requests, assign requests to our Trust & Safety contact: trust@redwood.ai. For elevated legal questions, Marissa will be the Redwood contract owner on this account (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).

If Summit confirms the 14-day retention and the temporary access workflow, I will add the configuration notes to the internal runbook and include the KV-cache disable flag in the customer profile.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: security-evidence-brief.pdf (PDF)

Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data handling commitments & next steps

Emily —

Thanks, and appreciate the quick clarifying questions. This is all good from a contracts perspective. Confirming the next formal steps: 

• Redwood will: 
  - Record a Training Exclusion on the Summit Health account that prevents any customer data from being used for model improvement.
  - Configure the EU tenant with 14-day default log retention and an audited export process for regulatory holds (manual export up to 12 months with Summit sign-off).
  - Disable persistent KV cache for the account by default; Soojin will add the runbook entry.

• Legal: I will attach the signed addendum to the existing Service Agreement and push the DocuSign envelope to your procurement contact once I have your one-line confirmation.

• Audit contact & escalation: For SOC requests use trust@redwood.ai; for contract questions use marissa_cole@redwood.ai. For urgent service issues we will provide a named escalation engineer.

Emily — if you reply here with the single sentence: "Summit Health confirms no-model-learning, 14-day retention with manual export for regulatory holds, and SFTP for redacted debugging bundles" we will consider this the written confirmation needed to proceed and begin the DocuSign flow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments sent: training_exclusion_addendum.pdf (PDF)
